There are a few crosslink opportunities here. First of all, this SCP mentions "cave paintings" containing the SCP, which seems to be a reference to SCP-001-EX-J, another joke scp about an ancient Foundation. In addition, this SCP also mentions SCP-173, but doesn't crosslink to it. I propose a crosslink there as well.

Cave paintings in ████████████, Indonesia, dated to roughly 41,000 BCE.

bottom text

Anyways, this started out as a mainlister riff on those articles that include Foundation analogues that are a bit TOO close to the Foundation for belief. But then I had trouble taking the premise seriously, and kept wanting to add jokes, so I just went and made it a -J. It's more of a snickering -J than a laugh-out-loud -J, if that helps.

"Meeting of the Royal Society of London for Improving Natural Knowledge in which Certain Items of an Incongruous Nature are Presented and Discussed" is a tongue-in-cheek Foundation analogue mentioned by spikebrennan here. The 'my ass' one is from Tumblr, I think.
